=INSERT INTO chat_logs (session_id, user_prompt, ai_message, generated_schema, generated_data_sample, record_count, success, error_message, user_agent)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.sessionId }}',
  '{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.chatInput.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Response Parser').item.json.parsedResponse?.message?.replace(/'/g, "''") || 'Schema generated' }}',
  $1,
  $2,
  {{ $json.response?.recordCount || 100 }},
  true,
  NULL,
  '{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.headers["user-agent"]?.replace(/'/g, "''") || 'rag-workflow' }}'
)
RETURNING id;
